incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-78923 — prod-api LB TLS handshake failures (multiple customers reporting SSL errors)

pagerduty: PD-78923 triggered on backend_error_rate (prod-api) — urgency: high — Escalation: paged oncall

maria (oncall): I’m on it. seeing client TLS handshake errors in logs (OpenSSL: ssl3_get_server_certificate:certificate verify failed). Starting live triage.

kevin (neteng): Looking at ALB target health now. If cert rotated recently might be cert chain issue. Which cert did we push last deploy?

laura (platform): We rotated leaf certs for infra last night at ~02:10 UTC, chain was uploaded by cert-rotator job. No rollback yet.

maria (oncall): Repro steps from monitoring: many requests to api.redwood.ai returning TLS handshake aborts, SNI correct. Error spike at 11:23 UTC.

sam (support): Several customers in EU reported 502/525 in app logs and user sessions failing to connect. Tickets coming in.

kevin (neteng): Running health check on ALB targets:
```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/prod-api
```
returns a lot of UNHEALTHY with reason TLSHandshakeError

maria (oncall): Can you paste the exact target error?

kevin (neteng): snippet from describe-target-health: "Health check failed: tls: first record does not look like a TLS handshake" on a subset of nodes in eu-west-1

laura (platform): That usually means the health-check port expecting HTTPS got HTTP or cert mismatch on the instance. The rotation process updated NGINX configs; maybe the chain not installed to the right path.

ops-bot: Automated check: last successful deploy to prod-api: deploy-2026-03-12T02:09Z (cert-rotator job v3.4.1)

maria (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) failover traffic away from eu-west-1 -> route to fallback region (us-west-2) 2) remove eu health checks so ALB stops marking targets 3) revert cert on eu nodes if we confirm chain issue. Thoughts?

kevin (neteng): I can update routing policy to prefer us-west-2 and increase weight there. Doing that now.

kevin (neteng): `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://change.json` applied (weighted routing) — shifting ~85% traffic to us-west-2 as immediate mitigation.

maria (oncall): Running manual TLS probe against an affected EU host:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect eu-node-12.internal:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -showcerts
```
Output: `verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate` — chain missing leaf->intermediate.

laura (platform): Confirmed: cert-rotator uploaded cert but missed intermediate chain file on a subset of hosts due to a race in the bootstrap script. Reproduced locally.

sam (support): Customer impact: ~12% of total traffic, concentrated in EU. Major customers on EU region complaining about SSL failures, billing unaffected.

maria (oncall): Acknowledge page PD-78923.

pagerduty: PD-78923 acknowledged by maria (oncall) — escalation stopped.

kevin (neteng): While we route traffic away, recommend fixing chain on EU nodes in-place rather than full rollback. I’ll push the corrected chain to the nodes and restart nginx.

laura (platform): I have a fix ready: cert-rotator v3.4.2 includes atomic write of chain file and verification step. Rolling to affected hosts via runbook now.

maria (oncall): Please run on one node first and confirm LB target becomes healthy.

kevin (neteng): Patch applied to eu-node-12, restarted nginx, re-run health check: target state -> healthy. Logs show full chain served.

laura (platform): Rolling patch to remaining eu nodes (batches of 3). Using `ssh ... && sudo systemctl restart nginx` via orchestrator.

ops-bot: deployment note: cert-rotator v3.4.2 rollout to eu nodes 50% complete (6/12)

sam (support): Noted reduction in new support tickets. Users report restored connectivity.

maria (oncall): Monitoring error rate and TLS handshakes. 11:58 UTC spike returning to baseline.

kevin (neteng): Weighted routing back to normal now (removed the 85% weighting).

ops-bot: cert-rotator v3.4.2 rollout complete to all eu nodes.

maria (oncall): Running post-fix checks: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health` against eu edge returns 200 and TLS handshake ok.

sam (support): Customer impact estimate: ~12% of requests affected during 11:23–11:58 UTC window. No data loss. Several high-priority support tickets opened; CS informed.

laura (platform): Root cause: race condition in cert-rotator bootstrap that skipped writing intermediate chain on some hosts during last rotation. Fix: add atomic file write + verification step. Also adding a canary for EU region during cert rotations.

maria (oncall): Severity -> Sev2. Escalation notes captured. Continuing monitoring for 30m.

kevin (neteng): Handing off to laura (platform) for post-incident cleanup and postmortem. Laura, I’m available if you need neteng for rollback/traffic tests.

maria (oncall): Handoff: maria -> laura at 12:15 UTC. Oncall reliever on duty: kevin (neteng) for infra questions.

laura (platform): Taking over. I'll open the incident doc and postmortem: https://redwood-internal/incident/PD-78923 (placeholder)

ops-bot: Incident closed by laura (platform). All systems nominal.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Good job on quick mitigation and rollbackless fix.

sam (support): I’ll send a follow-up to affected customers with timeline and mitigation summary.

laura (platform): Postmortem action items: 1) add atomic write & verify step (done in v3.4.2) 2) add canary for EU cert rotations 3) add more precise alerting to detect partial chain installs (modifying SLO alerts).

maria (oncall): Closing channel. Postmortem assigned to laura.

incident-bot: This thread has been archived for auditing. :white_check_mark:
